## Regenerating

```powershell
# The adoption row reads the generated consumer adoption matrix and the declared consumer set,
# both of which live outside this repository; supply them or the row reports `not yet`.
$env:TOOLUP_ADOPTION_MATRIX = '<path to the generated adoption matrix>'
$env:TOOLUP_ADOPTION_CONSUMERS = '<consumer column header>[;<another>]'
dotnet run --project Build.fsproj -- V1Readiness            # regenerates this file
dotnet run --project Build.fsproj -- V1Readiness --require-ready   # exit 1 unless every row passes
```

Thresholds are declared in `v1-readiness.json`; a decision to accept a measured value is a change to that file, recorded in git. The consumer set is declared beside the matrix, outside this repository.
